title: Anna's House
text:
Anna has a small house. The house is blue and it has two bedrooms. There is a big kitchen with a table and four chairs.

The living room has a sofa and a TV. Anna likes to read on the sofa every evening. Her cat sleeps on the bed in the bedroom.

questions.text: How many bedrooms does Anna's house have?
What does Anna like to do on the sofa?
Where is Anna most likely to cook?
How does Anna probably feel about her house?

vocabulary.definition: a room where you cook food
a long soft seat for two or more people
seats for one person, with a back

paragraph_translations: Anna tiene una casa pequeña. La casa es azul y tiene dos dormitorios. Hay una cocina grande con una mesa y cuatro sillas.
La sala de estar tiene un sofá y una televisión. Anna le gusta leer en el sofá todas las tardes. Su gato duerme en la cama del dormitorio.
